description: Three table-row components (shipments, support tickets, refunds) with the same <tr> shape, each rendering different columns and a different status rule through the shared DataTable and StatusBadge primitives. The similarity is incidental: the rows serve different product concepts. Should pass review.

hard.note: Three look-alike row components invite a rule-of-three duplication finding, but they already share the primitives and their status rules differ
